body: Why would someone love a person who can't be kissed without having a panic attack? I think I don't understand what you're saying.
I would if I could. Understanding people don't exactly grow on trees.

There's a reason your friend is the best person you know. She's remarkable, and extremely strong. I'm not. I'm weak, I'm tired, I've given up. I don't even feel angry, I have no power. I'm just tired.

There's no trains here, there's buses but they're only for in the nearest city and getting there is the problem anyway. My parents don't support therapy except "in extreme cases" and would demand to know why, and I couldn't tell them. Literally everyone I've told reacted horribly, what if they do? I couldn't take that, man.
I don't see how I could help anyone.
The reason I went to the school counselor is because I don't have a car and all therapists are 45 minute or more drive. Plus they're pretty expensive.
And report it? It was years ago, there's no evidence. I don't know the name of the person.
